pages.text: $(l)Why was my craft refused?$()$(br)The item is disabled in the config, or this world already made its cap. Check /creativeforge counts.$(br2)$(l)Did I lose the inputs?$()$(br)No. The grid is ejected in front of the crafters. Pick it up before it despawns (5 minutes).

$(l)Can I get a slot back if a crate is destroyed?$()$(br)Not by itself: the counter counts items made. An admin can lower it with /creativeforge set.$(br2)$(l)What does /creativeforge set do?$()$(br)It overwrites the counter for one item, for example after a rollback.
